newsitem.title: CHINA: Volkswagen China plant to make 46,000 cars in 97.
newsitem.headline: Volkswagen China plant to make 46,000 cars in 97.

text.p: FAW-Volkswagen Automotive Co, a joint-venture between China's First Automotive Corp (FAW) and German automaker Volkswagen AG, plans to make 46,000 cars in 1997, the Market Daily said on Thursday.
The joint venture, in Changchun in northeastern Jilin province, completed construction in 1996 and has an annual production capacity of 150,000 Jetta cars.
Company officials have said the plant had been operating well below full capacity because of poor market conditions.
Production of the Jetta sedan was expected to reach 40,000 units in 1997, the Market Daily said.
The company would use more advanced engines in the Jetta and improve its external design to attract more buyers, it said.
China produced 389,200 sedan cars in 1996, up 23.36 percent compared with 1995, state media said.
